schema: R15c follow-up calibration gates (FR-180, FR-181, FR-183; Maintainer decisions D-77 and D-78, 2026-10-21)
status: pre-registered before any follow-up run and before the leave-pair-out code exists; the R15c gates of 2026-10-13 and their FAIL verdicts for V180 and V181 are not changed

lpo_null.scenario: null, LOOCV scheme with the leave-pair-out AUC estimator (ridge and lasso)
lpo_null.rule: |mean - 0.5| <= 0.03 and mean + 1.96 SE <= 0.53 on the leave-pair-out AUC
lpo_null.source: FR-183 (a), the R14f null rule, applied to the leave-pair-out estimator (D-77)

lpo_planted.scenario: planted signal, LOOCV scheme with the leave-pair-out AUC estimator (ridge and lasso)
lpo_planted.source: the planted-signal AUC rule of the R15c pre-registration (proposed, pending Maintainer confirmation), applied unchanged

rf_permutation_diagnostic.scenario: null, random forest, whole-procedure permutation P with B = 99

rules.type_i: binomial P(K >= k | rate 0.05) >= 0.01, with K the number of P <= 0.05 (unchanged rule)
rules.uniformity_original: chi-square goodness-of-fit P over the B + 1 attainable values >= 0.01 (unchanged rule; expected count 2 per value, reported as written)
rules.uniformity_binned: chi-square goodness-of-fit P over 10 equal bins of the B + 1 attainable values (10 values per bin, expected 20 per bin) >= 0.01
rules.ties: for every dataset the number of permutations whose AUC equals the observed AUC within 1e-12 is recorded, and the mid-P (ties counted one half) is reported beside the production P; descriptive, no gate

rf_permutation_diagnostic.source: D-78: diagnostic of the V180 FAIL. It is a new, larger run of the same production procedure; V180 keeps its 2026-10-13 FAIL unless the Maintainer decides otherwise on the evidence

design.lpo: 12 vs 12 biological units, 200 pure-noise features (planted: five features +1.5 SD in the positive class); leave-pair-out over every positive x negative unit pair; inner 3-fold tuning; top-5 by AUC on the training data; the AUC is the mean over pairs of 1[s_pos > s_neg] + 0.5 x 1[s_pos = s_neg]
design.rf_diagnostic: 15 vs 15 biological units, 200 pure-noise features, 2 x 5-fold repeated stratified outer, inner 3-fold, top-5 by AUC, random forest with 500 trees

seeds.family_offset: +1000 x family index (penalized_logistic 0, lasso 1, random_forest 5), as in the R15c pre-registration
